subject.statement: Changpeng Zhao is still serving his prison sentence.

summary: Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty in November 2023 and was sentenced to about four months in prison in early 2024, completing his term and being released by mid‑2024. As of 2026‑10‑01 he is not incarcerated.
